name: Trap Bar Deadlift
steps: Step into the centre of the trap bar with feet hip width.
Bend hips and knees to grab the handles, arms straight by your sides.
Flatten your back, lift your chest and look ahead.
Drive through your feet to stand up tall, hips and knees straightening together.
Sit the hips back and lower the bar to the floor under control.
cues: Breathe in and brace, breathe out at the top

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back to reach the handles
common_mistakes.fix: Bend the knees more and keep the chest lifted
Push the floor away so hips and shoulders rise together

common_mistakes.mistake: Dropping the bar on the way down
common_mistakes.fix: Lower it with control, same path as the lift
